cards.name: Topsoil Turner
cards.oracleText:
Reach
When this creature enters, each Forest and Treefolk card in your hand perpetually gains "{T}: Add {G}{G}."

cards.name: Topsy Turvy
cards.oracleText:
The phases of each player's turn are reversed. (The phases are, in reverse order, ending, second main, combat, first main, and beginning.)
As long as there are more than two players in the game, the turn order is reversed.

cards.name: Top-Secret Tunnel
cards.oracleText: Whenever you crank this Contraption, target creature can't be blocked this turn.
